recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆大型漿細胞（核偏心、細胞質深藍、核旁有淡染區）細胞質內可見數根細長針狀的結晶包涵體，看似 Auer 小體（pseudo-Auer rods），實為免疫球蛋白結晶；背景有數顆帶顆粒的骨髓前驅細胞。
features: Large plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus, clumped chromatin and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Paranuclear pale zone (hof) in the plasma cell
Several thin, needle-like, pink-purple crystalline rods within the plasma cell cytoplasm (pseudo-Auer rods)
Adjacent granulocytic precursors with eccentric nuclei and pink granular cytoplasm
Background of fat vacuoles and small dark nucleated cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus, clumped chromatin, a paranuclear hof, and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing several thin, needle-like crystalline inclusions resembling Auer rods. Surrounding granulocytic precursors and erythroid cells show no rod-like inclusions. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with intracytoplasmic immunoglobulin crystals (pseudo-Auer rods), in keeping with the reported IgG myeloma; plasma cell percentage, light-chain restriction by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry, and a screen for light-chain crystal-associated organ damage should be assessed.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with true Auer rods
ddx.vs: True Auer rods occur in myeloblasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and MPO positivity, not in plasma cells with clumped chromatin and a hof.
APL faggot cells are hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and bundles of MPO-positive rods, with coagulopathy and PML::RARA fusion.
Crystal-storing histiocytes are macrophages with abundant cytoplasm packed with crystals and CD68/CD163 positivity rather than plasma cell morphology.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies or Mott cells
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are round globular immunoglobulin inclusions, not elongated needle-shaped crystals.
